title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Lena Morales
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad for SOC2 readiness tasks, control mapping notes, and open questions to triage with the team. Not official - copy into the control-mapping draft doc after we align.

Top-level status (my view):
- Inventory mostly done for infra and hosted API components, gaps remain for Dedicated/Private (on-prem) artifacts and for developer offboarding evidence.
- Policies: Acceptable use + data retention are drafted but need sign-off from Legal.
- Evidence collection: logs retention screenshots + ACL lists partially captured. Need procedural docs for recovery testing and incident response drills.

Open questions / todo (triage during sync):
- [ ] Which environment do we use for example evidence for Dedicated customers? (staging vs. dedicated-dev) - ask @Arjun.
- [ ] Confirm retention period for system logs for hosted-api (30 vs 90 days) - impacts monitoring controls.
- [ ] Need list of people with console admin for Private installs and corresponding offboarding events for last 12 months. Who owns this? (maybe SRE + Sales Ops)
- [ ] Are there formal encryption key rotation docs for KMS/HSM integrations used in Private? I can only find implementation notes in repo (aws-kms.md) not process docs.

Control mapping snippets (working draft):
- CC1: Organization and governance - owner: Security; artifacts: org-chart, security policy doc (security/policy-v1.2.pdf), meeting minutes (security-ops-2024-03-08). Notes: need evidence of periodic review (last review Jan 2024).
- CC4: Access controls - owner: IAM/SRE. Evidence: console ACL export (iam-acl-2024-04.csv), admin access list, MFA enforcement screenshots. Gap: developer role segregation for feature branches (some service accounts granted overly broad perms). Action: create ticket JIRA-2910 to restrict SA perms.
- CC6: Logical & physical access to system components - owner: infra. Evidence: datacenter contracts + cloud provider SOC2 attestations. For Private on-prem, need customer-signed attestations or checklist for handover.
- CC7: Change management - owner: release-engineering. Evidence: changelog + PR approvals. Need formal emergency change process doc; currently ad-hoc notes in release channel.

Incident response / monitoring notes:
- We have PagerDuty runbooks but not tabled evidence of DR callouts tied to real incidents. Need one post-incident report (format) and attach to control. Possibly use incident-2024-02-14 postmortem (draft).
- Logging: ELK retention set to 90 days for hosted, but Dedicated customers sometimes request longer - track exceptions in a log-retention-exceptions sheet.

Data classification + handling:
- Need a short doc that maps data types to handling procedures (PII, customer prompts, embeddings). Draft: data-classification-v0.3.md in repo. Pending legal review.
- Embeddings: are they considered "customer confidential" by default? We currently treat embeddings as customer-owned but need explicit policy for hosted vs private.

Evidence collection checklist (quick):
- [x] Inventory of systems (hosts, services) - inventory-2024-04.csv
- [ ] Access control lists & MFA enforcement screenshots - partial
- [ ] Policy docs (security, incident response, change mgmt) - drafts exist
- [ ] Backup verification logs and restore test results - missing (need schedule)
- [ ] Vendor SOC2 attestations (cloud provider) - obtained
- [ ] Role assignments and offboarding records - partial

Notes for next sync with Maya/Ryan (agenda items):
1) Go over JIRA-2891 (control mapping review) and assign owners for CC4 and CC7 gaps.
2) Prioritize producing one restore test evidence artifact for backups (owner: release-eng).
3) Decide canonical location for evidence (confluence vs drive); I recommend Confluence page per control with embedded artifacts.
4) Map Dedicated/private evidence requirements and list of customers who requested custom retention/APIs.

Rough timeline proposal (my suggestion):
- Week 1: finalize control owners + policies review (Legal sign-off target).
- Week 2: collect outstanding evidence (ACLs, backups, incident report).
- Week 3: remediation tickets + evidence upload.
- Week 4: internal dry-run audit and tidy up.

Random notes / fragments I want to keep:
- Slack convo from Feb: thread with compliance-team about embeddings and retention (link above).
- We may reuse parts of SOC2 mapping from last year's vendor readiness template - check shared_drives/company/ (not sure exact path).
- Might want to ask Sales for a template for Dedicated customer agreements, specifically for audit rights and log access.

Action items I will take this week:
- Pull admin access list and confirm MFA enforcement (target: 2024-06-07).
- Draft emergency change process doc skeleton and share for review (target: 2024-06-10).
- Create JIRA tickets for missing artifacts (JIRA-2910 created for SA perms).

Quick references:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/Control-Mapping
- Example PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/security/pull/134 (change mgmt notes)
- Incident draft: shared_drives/engineering/site-reliability-engineering/postmortems/incident-2024-02-14-draft.md

End of scratchpad. Copy relevant bits to control-mapping-draft after sync.

-- Lena
